corrected_fields.summary: This paper presents a geometric framework for studying multivariate tail-dependence compatibility in copulas, developing a witness representation indexed by active coordinate sets and sign patterns. The author derives a Moebius-type synthesis with explicit triangular inversion for complete signed tail families, and characterizes finite-threshold compatibility through nonnegative recovered generator weights and normalization constraints.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This is purely theoretical mathematical finance research examining the structural properties of copulas used in multivariate tail-dependence modeling. It does not directly address market structure (trading venues, market making, execution mechanics) or macro catalysts (economic data releases, central bank decisions). It provides foundational mathematical theory that may eventually inform risk models or derivative pricing but has no immediate practical implications for trading or macro strategy.
